newsitem.title: ESTONIA: ESTONIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 14.
newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JULY 14.

text.p: These were the main headlines from Estonia's Kuku radio noon news report on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- The opening ceremony of the Baltic Challenge exercise started in Paldiski.
- The maximum speed limit on the roads will be increased to 100 km/h from tomorrow.
